title: Golden System
statementMd:
Piegirl got bored with binary, decimal and other integer based counting systems. Recently she discovered some interesting properties about number ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cf667d5378aa3553058e0b348b30c37378759ffd.png), in particular that $*q*^{2} = *q* + 1$, and she thinks it would make a good base for her new unique system. She called it "golden system". In golden system the number is a non-empty string containing 0's and 1's as digits. The decimal value of expression $*a*_{0}*a*_{1}...*a*_{*n*}$ equals to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/51c20c3ef1a1e517fd60f28ab2fdea1fd54d65c7.png).

Soon Piegirl found out that this system doesn't have same properties that integer base systems do and some operations can not be performed on it. She wasn't able to come up with a fast way of comparing two numbers. She is asking for your help.

Given two numbers written in golden system notation, determine which of them has larger decimal value.

## Input

Input consists of two lines — one for each number. Each line contains non-empty string consisting of '0' and '1' characters. The length of each string does not exceed $100000$.

## Output

Print "`>`" if the first number is larger, "`<`" if it is smaller and "`=`" if they are equal.

## Note

In the first example first number equals to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9c955eec678d6e7dcdc7c94fb203e922d2ad19ad.png), while second number is approximately $1.618033988^{2} + 1.618033988 + 1 ≈ 5.236$, which is clearly a bigger number.

In the second example numbers are equal. Each of them is $≈ 2.618$.
statementZhMd:
Piegirl 厌倦了二进制、十进制以及其他基于整数的计数系统。最近，她发现了数字 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cf667d5378aa3553058e0b348b30c37378759ffd.png) 的一些有趣性质，尤其是 $*q*^{2} = *q* + 1$，她认为这个数字很适合作为她的新型独特进制。她将其称为“黄金系统”。在黄金系统中，一个数是一个非空字符串，其中的数字为 0 和 1。表达式 $*a*_{0}*a*_{1}...*a*_{*n*}$ 的十进制值等于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/51c20c3ef1a1e517fd60f28ab2fdea1fd54d65c7.png)。

很快，Piegirl 发现这个系统并不具备整数进制系统的相同性质，有些运算无法在其中进行。她无法想出一种快速比较两个数的方法。现在请你帮助她。

给定两个用黄金系统表示的数，判断它们的十进制值哪个更大。

## 输入格式

输入由两行组成，每行包含一个数。每行均为由字符 '0' 和 '1' 组成的非空字符串。每个字符串的长度不超过 $100000$。

## 输出格式

如果第一个数较大，输出 "`>`"；如果较小，输出 "`<`"；如果两者相等，输出 "`=`"。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，第一个数等于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9c955eec678d6e7dcdc7c94fb203e922d2ad19ad.png)，而第二个数约为 $1.618033988^{2} + 1.618033988 + 1 ≈ 5.236$，显然第二个数更大。

在第二个样例中，两个数相等。它们的值均约为 $2.618$。
